instruction: Create a Thunderbird filter to move all unread emails older than 30 days to an Archive folder. Configure this locally in Thunderbird only.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a filter based on age and read status. The evaluator verifies an enabled filter with 'Move to folder' action to Archive folder exists.
metadata.verification: Evaluator checks Thunderbird filter configuration file for expected filter rules with appropriate action and enabled status.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete requirement coverage: The evaluator verifies all instruction requirements - enabled status, 'Move to folder' action, Archive folder target, unread status condition, and age > 30 days condition

Correct regex pattern verification: The metric function uses regex_match method (lines 43-59) with semantically correct patterns: 'Status.*(?:is not|isn't).*Read' matches unread status, and 'Age in Days.*(?:is greater than|>).*30' matches age > 30 days

Proper condition validation: Unlike simple substring matching, the regex patterns verify both the condition field name AND the operator AND the value, ensuring 'Status is not Read' (not just 'Status') and 'Age in Days is greater than 30' (not just 'Age in Days')
Appropriate postconfig: The evaluator closes the Message Filters window before reading the filter file, ensuring the configuration is saved to disk
Correct data flow: Getter fetches the Thunderbird filter configuration file from VM, metric parses it and validates filter rules using regex matching against expected patterns
